name: 5-Seenweg: five lakes under the Matterhorn
why: From Blauherd down past five small lakes, three of them mirroring the Matterhorn on a calm morning, to the Sunnegga funicular.
book: Sunnegga-Rothorn lift ticket up to Blauherd.
water: Restaurants at Blauherd, Grindjisee and Sunnegga.
dangers: Afternoon thunderstorms in summer: be off the high paths by 14:00.

points.name: Stellisee
points.note: The lake with the most famous Matterhorn reflection.

points.name: Grindjisee
points.note: A small lake in larch and stone pine, with the Matterhorn reflected.

points.name: Grünsee
points.note: The warmest of the five, under the Findel glacier's old moraine; swimming in summer.

points.name: Moosjisee
points.note: A milky green reservoir lake fed by glacier water.

points.name: Leisee
points.note: The family lake by Sunnegga, with a raft and a play area.
